newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Scott Corp sees 20 pct profit fall.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Scott Corp sees 20 pct profit fall.

text.p: Transport group Scott Corp Ltd said on Wednesday that it expected its half year profit after tax to be about 20 percent lower than that of a year earlier.

The Mount Gambier-based company said the half year to December had been affected by significant redundancies through the restructuring of the group, higher distillate prices and lower economic activity, particularly in the building industry.

"It is anticipated profit before abnormals, interest and income tax will be approximately 10 percent less than the corresponding period in the previous year whilst profit after tax could be approximately 20 percent less for that period," the company said in a statement to the Australian Stock Exchange.
Scott Corp reported a net profit of A$5.19 million for the year to June 1996, down from A$5.51 million a year earlier.
Net profit in the 1995/96 first half was A$3.58 million, down from A$3.84 million a year earlier.
Scott Corp shares last traded on January 19 at A$2.30.
